news_tips_intro: 3 essential protocols for high-precision material recovery and AI computer-vision classification.
news_tip_1_body: Empty residual liquids, give containers a quick cold rinse, and screw HDPE/PP caps back onto PET bottles so small closures are recovered on sorting lines.
news_tip_2_body: Never place swollen cells, vapes, or power banks into curbside bins. Tape exposed terminals with clear non-conductive tape and route to verified E-Waste hubs.
news_tip_3_body: Place the item against a neutral surface with resin codes (#1–#7) or neck seams visible, and pin 2 GIoU keypoints on the cap and body for accurate AI classification.

about_headline: Turn everyday waste into clear circular action.
about_lead: Point your camera at any discarded item. Iris isolates the object, identifies its material, and gives you step-by-step disposal instructions and nearby drop-off locations.

about_step2_body: Iris identifies the material, recycling stream, and estimated recovery value.
about_step3_body: Follow clear disposal steps and find nearby drop-off points in your neighborhood.
